tests.name: TestServiceDryRunsWriteNothing
tests.reason: Integrate upstream non-root/system-unit portability fix while preserving the stronger current public dry-run artifact/privacy oracle. A non-root caller with an installed system unit must receive the existing authorization refusal; treating that legitimate refusal as an unconditional test failure is incorrect. Drop exact exception wording and arbitrary no-output/banner assertions.

evidence.independentSource: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-devices-phase-3-byo-research.md §2.1 service ownership and CLI dry-run contract; AGENTS.md secrets stay host-only. Existing TestPlanUninstall deterministically owns non-root/system-unit denial.
evidence.credibleFailure: Dry run leaks or consumes a bootstrap token or writes service/user state; test wrongly rejects legitimate privilege denial on a non-root machine with a system service; wrong failure reason is not accepted.
evidence.independentOracle: Independently authored source-token marker and contents, temporary HOME/data directory absence/contents, literal public ORQ config keys/target paths. Privilege expectation comes from OS effective UID and stat of the independently specified /etc/systemd/system/orq-agent.service path, not a production helper/constant.
evidence.stableSeam: Public InstallServiceCommand/UninstallServiceCommand with DryRun=true; caller-visible error reason and actual temporary filesystem/token artifacts.
evidence.refactorResistance: Use semantic system-service/sudo refusal markers rather than whole exception prose; permit informational output and avoid template formatting. Preserve cache/runner-independent actual artifact checks.
evidence.uniqueProtection: The public dry-run owner uniquely verifies no side effects and no credential disclosure through real command wiring. Pure plan privilege tests do not verify real config/file handling; no duplicate leaf is added.

tests.validationCommand: cd apps/box-agent && GO=/usr/local/go/bin/go node scripts/go.mjs test -race -run '^TestServiceDryRunsWriteNothing$' ./internal/agent
